contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTI NVS IVN NC ; R/ BEAT TRA NQLITAS

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), Beat Tranqlitas issue of 322-324, Reece period 16, London mint. Obverse description: Helmeted bust cuirassed left. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTI NVS IVN NC. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VOT/IS/XX, three stars over. Reverse inscription: BEAT TRA NQLITAS. In exergue: PLON. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.0mm, Weight: 1.95gms, die axis: 6
